scope: 普通历练收入与封顶、升天历练生成/领取天机石、普通及升天气功洗点；明确项目采用，不冒充官方全部数值。
source_policy: 原参考的历练奖励/高阶消费和升天历练1008原文不改。以下收入档、进度阈值/增量、领取和长白山参采用范围均为项目设计。

practice.group_pool: floor(base * (20 + eligible_count - 1) / 20); allocate by eligible level weights with stable-id remainder
practice.cap_policy: show allocated/applied/overflow; never redistribute personal overflow
practice.quest_rewards: explicit independent integer amounts; never infer from xp or empty reward text

ascension_progress.group_pool: separate subgroup meeting rank/monster-level qualification; same 5% bonus and level-weighted allocation
ascension_progress.overflow_policy: remainder keeps modulo 10000; pending stones credit only remaining capacity; display lost excess; never create inventory implicitly

stone_claim.output_capacity: check real backpack after pending debit; capacity failure changes neither pending nor inventory

qigong_respec.refund: only actual allocated owned points back to same qigong pool
qigong_respec.temporal_effects: remove self sustained effects directly requiring cleared allocations; completed standalone effects retain originally paid duration; never reset cooldowns or extend effects

transactions: all inputs/outputs/progress/allocations/cap result/request id commit together; LAN host authority and original settlement replay; no default values for missing reward fields

item_definitions.use_policy_owner: 14合同4.2/4.6; real bag conversion/quest input/reset output only
item_definitions.acquisition: explicit cultivation claim/quest award/actual invested-point refund; never an implicit shop purchase

item_definitions.use_policy_owner: qigong conversion/reset contract; do not confuse with passive-point reset
qigong_respec; one real bag item, scope ordinary/ascended passive allocations only

item_parameter_authority: item_definitions structures the existing17合同6.1/6.2 parameters; readable document is its view, not a second runtime source. Yuegong vendor outside current initial subgraph remains a full-world binding dependency.
